metadata.comment: Set by a grown-up in the project's .env (GROWNUP_KEY=...). Never wired into a Response.
A wrong guess waits two seconds before answering, so guessing the key by trying is slow.
createRole stays off: the grownup role is made once on the backend, and a typo here must fail rather than invent a role nobody checks.
